My 4yo son is really into space right now, and loves his Lego. I wanted to get him a space-themed set but didn't really see anything reasonable currently on the market. During a business trip I found a Chinese knockoff company that makes LOADS of different sets. I bought two space sets:

http://slimgur.com/images/2015/06/19/8bfa47f23306c9149a62419a08fc56f0.jpg

http://slimgur.com/images/2015/06/19/d168f5baa8b130327bc71259cbaababa.jpg

These two sets together were 81 RMB total (~$13), including shipping within China. I've seen Chinese knockoffs before and they were quite terrible, but the quality of these sets really surprised me. The fit was not quite as good as real Lego, but I'd say they're only 5 to 10% off the ideal.

Most importantly, my son absolutely loves them. Now he has rockets, a moon rover, satellites, and a space man to place with.
How do you feel about Lego clones?

But I support any kids desire to use a brick system to further their learning and play. That said, while those sets don't look like a rip off of and LEGO set I know of, Enlighten is a horrible company that makes exact copies of LEGO sets and passes them as their own. They are likely one of the reasons that LEGO feels so strongly about information leaking before they want it to. They don't want a company like Enlighten to copy their new set and get it to market before them. At least other clones/competitors go get their own ideas and licensing.
